svg.title: Juan Camilo Grisales. More possible. Less in the way.
svg.desc: What looks like GitHub's own contribution graph and activity feed (4,961 contributions in the last year) splits open between Wednesday and Thursday. The lower half drops away. Beneath the surface: More possible. Less in the way. Powerful systems, simple experiences. Under the interface lies the system itself, drawn like a chip seen from above: intent comes in, memory, tools and a reasoning core work on it, the result is verified, and it leaves as one simple control. AI engineer and product builder in Medellín, Colombia.

g.text: ONE INTENTION IN · ONE CONTROL OUT
